fields.title: spec-mcp resolves missing workspace to the wrong existing store
spec-mcp resolves missing workspace to the wrong existing store

fields.__previous_description__:
## Summary

When the requested workspace has no local `.workflow-tools/spec` store, spec-mcp can resolve the request to an unrelated existing spec store instead of initializing the requested workspace. In the affected case, calls issued for `C:/Users/linus/git/resume-latex` opened a different store containing duplicate `root/generated-artifacts` records and failed with `duplicate slug: root/generated-artifacts`, even though `resume-latex/.workflow-tools/spec` does not exist.

## Evidence

Relevant code:

- `src/mcp/server.rs`, `SpecServer::resolve_workspace_root`: non-default workspace values are passed to `memory_kernel::workspace::resolve_store_root_from(Path::new(workspace), ".spec")`; the returned path is accepted when it looks like a `.spec` store.
- `src/mcp/server.rs`, `SpecServer::with_store`: calls `SpecStore::open_or_init(&index_root)` and then `store.scan(false)`.
- `crates/spec-api/src/store.rs`, `SpecStore::open_or_init`: initialization/opening is idempotent, but it cannot correct a wrong `index_root`.
- `crates/spec-api/src/store.rs`, `rebuild_slug_index`: scans all indexed manifests and returns `DuplicateSlug` when the selected store contains duplicate slugs.

The server process also derives its default `index_root` from the process current directory in `src/bin/spec-mcp.rs`; a long-lived MCP server therefore needs explicit, deterministic workspace resolution rather than relying on whichever directory the server was started from.

## Reproduction

1. Start/use the already-running spec-mcp server from a workspace that has no `.workflow-tools/spec` store, such as `C:/Users/linus/git/resume-latex`.
2. Call a spec tool with `workspace` set to that repository root, or use the default scope when the server was started from another repository.
3. Observe that the operation accesses an unrelated existing store or reports its data error, for example `duplicate slug: root/generated-artifacts`.
4. Confirm that `C:/Users/linus/git/resume-latex/.workflow-tools/spec` was not initialized.

## Expected behavior

A workspace-root request must resolve only to the deterministic store path for that workspace. If the local store is absent, the first store operation should initialize it there. It must never silently redirect to an unrelated ancestor, process-cwd store, or other existing store.

If a supplied path is ambiguous or cannot be resolved safely, return a clear invalid-workspace error containing the requested path and expected store location.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add regression tests for a workspace with no local spec store and for a workspace whose ancestor or process cwd has another spec store.
- Verify that the requested workspace gets its own initialized store.
- Verify that no unrelated store is opened or scanned.
- Preserve valid explicit `.spec` store and existing-workspace behavior.
- Return a deterministic diagnostic for invalid/ambiguous workspace paths.
- Verify the MCP `spec_list`/`spec_health` flow against a clean workspace with no pre-existing store.

## Scope

This ticket is limited to spec-mcp workspace/store resolution and initialization. It does not delete or reconcile records in any existing spec store.

## Execution Plan

1. Change explicit workspace resolution at the memory-kernel boundary so a supplied workspace is bounded to its canonical local `.workflow-tools/spec` store; retain direct explicit-store compatibility and ambient/default ancestor discovery.
2. Add resolver tests covering ancestor store isolation, no local store initialization, explicit store paths, nested paths, and canonical/legacy layout diagnostics.
3. Update `SpecServer::with_store` and response/error handling to retain and expose resolution context, initialization mode, and ancestor-lookup usage.
4. Add MCP integration coverage for `spec_list` and `spec_health` against a clean child workspace with a seeded duplicate-slug parent store.

## Validation Commands

- `cargo test -p memory-kernel resolve_store_root`
- `cargo test -p spec --test mcp_smoke explicit_workspace_resolution`
- `cargo test -p spec --test mcp_smoke spec_list_and_health_clean_workspace`
- `cargo test -p spec --test mcp_smoke --no-run`
- `cargo test -p spec --test mcp_smoke`

## Execution Boundaries

- Target repositories: `workflow-tools/memory-kernel` and `workflow-tools/spec`.
- No store-data deletion, reconciliation, broad migration, or UI changes.
- Preserve valid explicit `.spec` store and existing ambient/default behavior.
- Move to `in-review` only after implementation, validation, and spec traceability are current.

fields.__previous_part_content__:
## Execution Plan

1. Add `memory_kernel::workspace::resolve_explicit_store_root_from` to bound explicit spec workspaces to their own canonical or legacy store without selecting an ancestor store.
2. Preserve direct explicit `.spec` and `.workflow-tools/spec` paths; prefer canonical layout and return diagnostics when canonical and legacy layouts coexist.
3. Make `SpecServer` use bounded resolution for explicit workspace values and include requested workspace, resolved workspace root, active index root, prior store existence, initialization result, ancestor-lookup status, candidates, and selection reason in successful responses and post-resolution errors.
4. Emit startup resolution diagnostics from `spec-mcp` and per-call workspace resolution logs before store open.
5. Cover an ancestor store containing duplicate slugs, local child initialization, `spec_list`, `spec_health`, error context, and explicit store overrides.

## Validation Results

- `cargo test workspace::tests` from `workflow-tools/memory-kernel`: passed, 50 tests.
- `cargo test -p spec --features mcp --test mcp_smoke explicit_child_workspace_does_not_use_parent_spec_store -- --nocapture` from `workflow-tools`: passed.
- `cargo test -p spec --features mcp --test mcp_smoke spec_health_errors_include_workspace_resolution_context -- --nocapture` from `workflow-tools`: passed.
- `cargo test -p spec --features mcp --test mcp_smoke explicit_spec_store_path_remains_an_override -- --nocapture` from `workflow-tools`: passed.
- `cargo test -p spec --features mcp --test mcp_smoke` from `workflow-tools`: passed, 11 tests before adding the explicit-store override test; rerun after the final change.
- `cargo check -p spec --features mcp --bin spec-mcp` from `workflow-tools`: passed.
- `cargo test -p spec-api open_or_init --lib` from `workflow-tools`: passed.

## Remaining Validation

- Run the complete MCP smoke suite after the last added explicit-store test and logging adjustment.
- `cargo fmt --check` reports pre-existing formatting differences across untouched files and `memory-kernel/src/workspace_tests.rs`; avoid formatting unrelated code.

## Execution Boundaries

- Scope: `workflow-tools/memory-kernel` and `workflow-tools/spec`.
- No store-data deletion, reconciliation, broad migration, or UI changes.
- Existing unrelated edits in `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel.rs`, `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel/internal.rs`, `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel_types.rs`, and `spec/crates/spec-api/src/move_domain.rs` are not part of this ticket.

## Execution Summary

Implemented bounded explicit-workspace resolution, local canonical store initialization, deterministic canonical/legacy selection, startup and per-call resolution diagnostics, and MCP result/error context.

## Validation Results

- `cargo test workspace::tests` from `workflow-tools/memory-kernel`: passed, 50 tests.
- `cargo test -p spec --features mcp --test mcp_smoke` from `workflow-tools`: passed, 13 tests.
- `cargo check -p spec --features mcp --bin spec-mcp` from `workflow-tools`: passed.
- `cargo test -p spec-api open_or_init --lib` from `workflow-tools`: passed, 1 test.
- Focused MCP coverage includes duplicate-slug parent isolation, local child initialization, list and health behavior, response/error context, explicit store overrides, and invalid-workspace diagnostics.

## Validation Note

`cargo fmt --check --manifest-path spec/Cargo.toml` reports broad existing formatting differences across untouched and touched files. No repository-wide formatting was applied to avoid unrelated churn.

## Boundaries

- Scope: `workflow-tools/memory-kernel` and `workflow-tools/spec`.
- No store data deletion, reconciliation, broad migration, or UI changes.
- Existing unrelated edits in `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel.rs`, `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel/internal.rs`, `memory-kernel/src/storage/move_kernel_types.rs`, and `spec/crates/spec-api/src/move_domain.rs` were left untouched.
